question: Should `/workspace` become a supported compatibility path inside official gateway and CLI runtime containers, or remain reserved as a sandbox-container convention?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable, but the decision changes the documented container path contract and could affect Docker, Podman, custom mounts, and users distinguishing gateway containers from agent sandboxes.

options.title: Support the runtime alias
options.body: Add the image-level symlink while retaining `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as canonical, with Docker and Podman smoke tests plus explicit documentation of sandbox semantics.

options.title: Keep it sandbox-only
options.body: Do not add the alias; instead update agent-facing templates and container documentation so runtime-container instructions consistently use the canonical `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` path.

recommendation.title: Support the runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add the image-level symlink while retaining `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as canonical, with Docker and Podman smoke tests plus explicit documentation of sandbox semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across Docker image behavior, sandbox surfaces, and the existing review discussion.
